$comment: Declared versions NOT published from this repository, each with the reason.
State is computed from this repository's git tags. a1 and a2 were published
from dotmac_starter_mt and their tags stay there permanently.
0.1.0a8 is DECLARED and not yet published. The row below is what keeps
test_the_declared_version_is_accounted_for green between the declaration and
the publication, and it must be removed in the change that publishes — which
is now the RECORDER's job rather than a human's.
That change is the point of a8. Everything the record needs was already
computed by verify-release.yml, which ended by printing `::notice::OWED`, a
notice nothing reads. The follow-up was missed twice: 0.1.0a4's row said
never-published and outlived its own publication by six hours, and 0.1.0a7's
absence turned protected main red for every open pull request — a4 failed
silently and a7 failed loudly at innocent people. The verify run now opens the
record itself, under the dedicated recorder identity, as a coordinates-only
pull request.
0.1.0a3 is published and permanently unpinnable; 0.1.0a4 is published,
independently verified, and refused for adoption; 0.1.0a5 is published,
verified on seven properties, and refused for adoption because its declared
dotmac-kernel floor is 21 alphas below the module it imports; 0.1.0a6 is
published, verified, and still pinnable; 0.1.0a7 is published, verified on
seven properties with nine behavioural canaries, publishes mod_deploy's
exact seven-table, 95-column structure, declares >=0.1.0a100, and is the
version to pin until a8 is published and recorded. All of them live in
docs/published-versions.json, each superseding disposition APPENDED to its
original record rather than replacing it.
A row here and a row in docs/published-versions.json are never both true
about one version at once, and
test_the_ledger_and_the_published_record_never_claim_the_same_version states
that over the two FILES so it holds even in a tagless checkout.

0.1.0a8.reason: Declared by the change that ports the release recorder, and not yet published. a8 carries #23's approved-plan read API — the authorized image set frozen INSIDE the plan digest, and find_approved_plan / require_approved_plan with eight typed refusals including revocation — which Platform CP needs for a verified receipt and Observability needs so a promotion can verify an approved plan rather than trust caller-supplied authorized_images. Neither may pin it until it exists. This row is removed by the recorder's coordinates-only pull request in the same change that records a8's coordinates; it is deliberately NOT removed by hand, because remembering has failed twice here.
